API Reference

This section documents the Python API of MicroPyzzotMet. It is intended for users who want to integrate the downscaling workflow into their own Python scripts or pipelines, rather than calling the command-line interface.

The pages below list the main public modules and functions, with signatures and docstrings extracted automatically from the code.
